# Pitex 1.0.4

This release adds BibTeX and Markdown to the New Document menu on macOS,
Ubuntu and Windows.

## Changes

- New Document is now a submenu offering LaTeX (.tex), BibTeX (.bib) and
  Markdown (.md) in the macOS File menu and editor "+" menu, and in the
  shared Ubuntu and Windows editor menu.
- Cmd+N on macOS and Ctrl+N on Ubuntu and Windows keep their behavior:
  they create a LaTeX document from the existing article template.
- New BibTeX and Markdown documents start as empty files. Every format
  uses its own `untitled` numbering sequence, so `untitled.bib` does not
  share the `untitled.tex` counter, and existing files are never
  overwritten.
- New documents are created in the open project's root and open in the
  editor like files picked in the sidebar.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 update to 1.0.4 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.4
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
